recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. A future work group could choose to add a separate targetElement-with-extension-id example, but FHIR-39392 is already satisfied and no current FHIR-core source correction is required.
issue_request: FHIR-39392 was an Applied FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6. The final resolution kept the existing n1/n2 targetElement examples as correct and requested an additional example showing Provenance pointing to a gender or race example.
initial_application: Commit 178eabcf88a65fe535d7572352f02a7931968d65 explicitly applied FHIR-39392 by adding a US Core race extension to source/patient/patient-example-c.xml, adding source/provenance/provenance-example4.xml using targetPath to point at that extension, and registering the example in source/provenance/list-Provenance-examples.xml.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread and FHIR-I minutes explain that targetElement identifies an element by id; an extension can be targeted that way only if the extension itself has an id. The applied example uses targetPath for the id-free race extension, which is consistent with the Extension Pack definition of targetElement/targetPath. Patient and Provenance are active resources in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source preserves the valid n1/n2 examples and includes the added Patient race-extension Provenance example requested by the final disposition.
